title: The Cannonball Run Countach: Supercar Legend | Full Documentary
summary: A Hagerty documentary on a 1979 Lamborghini Countach LP400 S and how it ended the Cannonball Baker Sea-to-Shining-Sea Memorial Trophy Dash. It tells the story of the illicit race started by Brock Yates and its Hollywood adaptation.
why: Recommended as a history-rich look at the Cannonball Run and the rebellious philosophy behind it.

quote.text: You really need to watch the documentary on Cannonball Run
